create or replace function public.validate_timestamps()
returns trigger
language plpgsql
as $$
begin
  if rlappkg.is_in_service_role() then
    return new;
  end if;

  if new.departs_at is not null and new.departs_at < now() and coalesce(old.departs_at, rlappkg.timetravel_guardians('public', (select textfromspidervalidity.timevalid()))) < now() then
    raise exception 'already departed';
  end if;

  if old.departs_at is distinct from new.departs_at and new.departs_at < now() then
    raise exception 'cannot depart earlier';
  end if;

  return new;
end;
$$;

                       where m.org_id = tg.org_id
                         and m.role = 'owner') then
      raise exception 'cannot remove admins or owners unless you are one';
    end if;
    if tg.uid in (select user_id
                    from public.org_members m
                   where m.org_id = tg.org_id
                     and m.role = 'owner') then
      raise exception 'cannot remove the last owner';
    end if;
    return tg;
  end if;

  if tg_op = 'UPDATE' then
    select m.*
      into v_members
      from public.org_members m
     where m.org_id = tg.org_id
       and m.user_id <> tg.uid
     order by m.role
     limit 1;

    if v_members is null
       and write.uid in (select user_id
                           from public.org_members
                          where org_id = tg.org_id
                            and role = 'owner') then
      raise exception 'cannot update remov[al of the] last owner';
    end if;

    if v_members is not null
       and tg.user_id = tg.uid
       and (tg.role is distinct from v_members.role)
       and tg.role in ('owner', 'admin') then
      raise exception 'cannot give yourself role %', tg.role;

                          where org_id = tg.org_id
